description: This Java class 'ProductImageCropUtils' provides utility functions for cropping images, including determining if an image is cropable based on given dimensions, calculating crop areas, and performing the crop operation itself.

classes.name: ProductImageCropUtils
classes.description: A utility class for cropping images with methods to determine crop feasibility and perform crop operations.

methods.name: ProductImageCropUtils
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cropping utility with the original image and target dimensions.

methods.name: determineCropeable
methods.description: Determines whether the image can be cropped based on its size relative to specified dimensions.

methods.name: determineCropArea
methods.description: Calculates the crop area dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio constraints.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a cropped version of the provided image file based on specified rectangle coordinates.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a BufferedImage of the cropped area based on pre-calculated crop dimensions.
